title: Honest Inference in Causal Panels with Unknown Rank and Factor Strength
banked_reason: The exact continuum minimax frontier and sharp simultaneous excess remain unproved; the sound finite-grid duality and constant-factor continuum interval achieve subfield rather than the field floor.
gap_reasons: The stated profile rule is an evaluable, union-honest constant-factor oracle construction, but it neither characterizes the stratumwise minimax expected lengths nor attains their simultaneous optimum (the exact excess remains only bracketed), so it is weaker than the promised attaining/sharp simultaneous deliverable.
The retry contains no solver-authored exact continuum theorem statement.
The superseding proofs establish only finite-grid duality and a [1,K_alpha] comparator, explicitly disclaiming sharpness.
proof_attempt_summary: The run proved the exact finite-grid simultaneous-regret primal/dual with finite-action purification, a strict mixture-versus-pairwise orbit witness, and an evaluable continuum union-honest profile interval with constant-factor stratumwise guarantees. Two directed attempts to pass from canonical finite nets to the exact continuum minimax frontiers and sharp simultaneous excess did not produce the required liminf/limsup coverage transfer, limiting Borel-measure duality, or deterministic continuum attainment. The surviving result is sound and reusable, but the exact continuum kernel remains open and the achieved novelty tier is subfield.
tldr: Union-wide honesty over unknown rank and factor strength is a composite testing problem, not a collection of pairwise Gaussian comparisons. For the public four-block causal-panel mask, the paper first solves the rank-zero-plus-sixty-four-orbit benchmark exactly through a finite-dimensional expected-length dual. The orbit is a legal exact-rank-two completion family with a common missing-block counterfactual mean. Its centered mixture cancels the first chi-square coefficient, but diagonal likelihood terms rule out the conjectured \(n^{1/4}\) rate gap for a fixed orbit. A certified local experiment nevertheless gives a strict constant gap between the full mixture dual and every pairwise dual. The remaining open object is a single rank-and-strength-free inversion over the continuum union, together with the sharp simultaneous excess if all stratum frontiers cannot be attained at once.
gap: Cai--Low ordered moduli price pairwise departures over convex Gaussian classes, mixture methods establish nonadaptivity in sparse and low-rank models, and current panel procedures either impose signal conditions or deliver strength-robust but non-sharp intervals. None characterizes scalar expected length under the deterministic four-block mask when exact rank and anchor strength are both unknown.
fill: The exact primal--dual identity, the strict mixture certificate, and the zero-strength lower envelope determine what the early benchmark actually says. The simultaneous-inversion question then asks for one data-only interval over the full union or the sharp excess that makes such oracle adaptation impossible.
